text_block_list.text:
It happened during dance practice in 
preparation for this upcoming live show—

text_block_list.name: Dance Instructor
text_block_list.text: "Right, turn there! And strike a pose!"

text_block_list.name: Dance Instructor
text_block_list.text:
That was wonderful, Bourbon-san! Your 
feelings truly shone through in that 
performance!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I have no "thoughts" to share.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In other words, I determine that there are 
no "feelings" present either.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I was given instructions. To achieve that 
performance, I danced and sang. Yet the 
teacher said, "Your feelings truly come 
through."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: What did I convey?
choice_data_list:
Maybe convey the feelings put into the 
lyrics?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...That is impossible for me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Pouring emotion into the lyrics. That is 
to say, such an action requires that one 
is able to empathize with them.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, there were many lyrics I could 
not understand. In that state, 
communicating them was impossible.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I'm still not capable of putting on a live 
like the one Falcon-san showed us before.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Conveying feelings with all one's might 
to someone"... That mission remains 
unfulfilled.
choice_data_list:
You really have a desire to 'reach' 
people, don't you?

You have a strong desire to "reach 
people," don't you?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...A desire to "reach them," is it?
choice_data_list:
I think those feelings really got through 
to them.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Preparations complete. Continuing movement 
to today's stage.

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
Um, Bourbon-san! Are you going on stage 
now?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Target, searching... complete. Are you the 
person who sent me a fan letter before?

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes. That's right! You remembered me?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for coming today.

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Ah. Calling out to you right before 
the concert! I'm sorry for getting in your 
way!

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry! I'll be looking forward to 
the concert!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Target, began running. Lost to a distance 
where communication is impossible.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Message to convey: "Your letter gave me 
energy"... Delivery failed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
............As expected, I am not good at 
expressing emotion.

And thus, the 3rd Live raised its 
curtains.
